meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频中的人声与配乐做混音:淡入淡出、交叉过渡、音量自动化、人声压过配乐、效果链与分组总控。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里已有旁白和背景音乐,却总在互相打架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover and music track keep fighting each other in the same video.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为已经放进 HyperFrames 组合的音频做混音：淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道音量与自动化包络、ducking、人声闪避，以及 EQ、压缩、限制器等效果链。
howto.when: 当音频已经放进 HyperFrames 组合、需要做混音时接管，例如加淡入淡出、ducking、效果链等。找 BGM 或做旁白属于 /media-use，剪辑时点与轨道布局属于 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给音乐床加上淡入和淡出
say.note: 对已放置的音轨写入淡入淡出

say.text: 让音乐床对着旁白组做 voiceover carve
say.note: carve 写在音乐床上，旁白组不动

say.text: 把这几条轨并到一个总线，末端挂个限制器
say.note: 用 hf-audio-group 建一条 submix 总线

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, ducking, voiceover carve, and effect chains such as EQ, compressor and limiter.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition and needs mixing, e.g. fades, ducking or an effect chain. Sourcing or generating audio is /media-use; clip timing and track layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Add a fade-in and a fade-out to the music bed.
say_en.note: Writes fades onto a placed track

say_en.text: Carve the music bed against the narration group.
say_en.note: Carve lives on the bed, not the voice

say_en.text: Put these tracks on one bus and add a limiter.
